The tool computes descriptive statistics for the numeric series; the exact physical quantity depends on the unit of your data (such as MPa), so state it when you analyze the results.
map.应力场参数统计：将多个台站或反演得到的应力张量分量（如 5.2/4.8/5.5/: Stress field parameter statistics: take the stress tensor components from multiple stations or inversions (such as 5.2/4.8/5.5/4.6/5.0) as data; the tool outputs the mean, standard deviation, and more, characterizing how concentrated or dispersed the regional stress field is.
map.构造背景研判：将统计结果用于区域构造应力场分区或地震危险性背景分析，支撑地震地质: Tectonic background assessment: use the statistical results to zone a regional tectonic stress field or to analyse the background seismic hazard, supporting seismological and geological research.
map.标准差小表示样本离散程度低、区域应力场较均匀（如本例 0.31）；若标准差大，则: A small standard deviation means the sample is tightly clustered and the regional stress field is fairly uniform (0.31 in this example); a large standard deviation indicates significant differences in stress direction or magnitude, possibly due to local tectonic disturbance or dispersed measurements.
